scope: flat leading Ozuch H^4 multipole gauge check only

interpretation.raw_H4_result: The row and column H^4 leading sums are trace-free, divergence-free and harmonic on R^4 minus the origin; the flat P_e source is zero away from the singularity.
interpretation.caution: This does not mean every invariant compact-product source is TT. The actual S_j^epsilon in c_ij=L_i G_P^perp S_j^epsilon is a distributional/cutoff/gauge-corrected object produced by matching the ALE and orbifold expansions and projecting away global kernel modes.
interpretation.use_for_next_step: The flat multipole can be used as the singular model for deriving source moments; the next missing piece is the compact-product Bianchi correction and projection, not a pointwise trace-free assumption.
